description:
Vital Recorder 1.16.6 is open on the Windows desktop with the file '0003.vital' from the VitalDB open dataset loaded in Track mode. The track window shows multiple waveform traces from a noncardiac surgery at Seoul National University Hospital. The timeline at the top spans the full recording duration. At the bottom of the window are playback controls: Play, Stop, Skip-to-Start, Step-Back, Step-Forward, and Skip-to-End buttons, along with a zoom control. The current view shows the entire recording duration.

Your task:
1. Navigate the timeline to the 'Surgery started' event marker. You can click on the 'Surgery started' entry in the event list on the right panel, or use the timeline and playback controls to reach that time position.
2. Once at the 'Surgery started' position, zoom into the timeline to see approximately 10-30 minutes of waveform detail around that event. You can use the zoom control (magnifying glass icon at the bottom-right) or scroll wheel to zoom in.
3. The zoomed view should clearly show individual waveform patterns (heartbeats in ECG, arterial pressure pulsations) around the Surgery started time point.
